zh-CN.title: 孟城
zh-CN.shortSummary: 孟城是庄子人物传统常用的地域入口，本条以现代城市尺度显示，不把传统一地名等同于确证活动地址。
curatorialDescription: 现实地图显示现代地理锚点；庄周关联属于传统/研究层，坐标不证明具体生平事件。
zh-CN.researchNote: 历史地名对应、地方文献和庄周活动证据需继续拆分；当前坐标来自策展区域登记。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 现代地理锚点；庄子传统关联

en.title: Mengcheng
en.shortSummary: Mengcheng is a commonly used regional gateway for traditions around Zhuangzi; it is shown at city scale and not as a confirmed activity address.
curatorialDescription: The real map shows a modern geographic anchor; the Zhuang Zhou association remains a traditional/research layer and the coordinate does not prove a specific life event.
en.researchNote: Historical place-name mapping, local records and evidence for Zhuang Zhou's activity require separation; the coordinate comes from the curatorial regional register.

displayDate.zh-CN: 现代地理锚点；庄子传统关联

zh-CN.title: 邹城
zh-CN.shortSummary: 邹城是孟子地域传统的现代城市尺度入口；地图点位表达区域，不替代战国诸侯游历的逐点证据。
curatorialDescription: 邹地传统与现代行政城市需要分开；本点用于把孟子人物入口放回山东南部的地理范围。
zh-CN.researchNote: 孟子生地、邹地历史范围和后世纪念地点需逐项核对；坐标暂属策展区域锚点。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 现代地理锚点；孟子地域传统

en.title: Zoucheng
en.shortSummary: Zoucheng is a city-scale gateway into regional traditions around Mencius; the point marks a region rather than the Warring States itinerary.
curatorialDescription: The Zou tradition and the modern administrative city remain distinct; this point returns the Mencius entry to a geographic range in southern Shandong.
en.researchNote: Birth traditions, the historical extent of Zou and later memorial sites require item-level review; the coordinate is currently a curatorial regional anchor.
en.timeLabel: Modern geographic anchor; Mencius regional tradition

displayDate.zh-CN: 现代地理锚点；孟子地域传统
displayDate.en: Modern geographic anchor; Mencius regional tradition

zh-CN.title: 鹤鸣山
zh-CN.shortSummary: 鹤鸣山是张道陵与天师道传承叙事中的传统山岳节点，现实坐标与神圣叙事保持分层。
curatorialDescription: 现实地图只显示山地锚点；授道、修炼和天师传承属于传统/后世层，不由坐标证明。
zh-CN.researchNote: 山名对应、道教遗迹和传记版本需继续核验；当前使用低置信区域坐标。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 东汉传统与后世道教记忆

en.title: Mount Heming
en.shortSummary: Mount Heming is a traditional mountain node in narratives of Zhang Daoling and the Celestial Masters; real coordinates and sacred narratives remain layered.
curatorialDescription: The real map shows a mountain anchor; revelations, cultivation and lineage belong to traditional/later layers and are not proved by a coordinate.
en.researchNote: Mountain-name mapping, Daoist remains and biographical versions require further verification; a low-confidence regional coordinate is used for now.
en.timeLabel: Eastern Han tradition and later Daoist memory

displayDate.zh-CN: 东汉传统与后世道教记忆
displayDate.en: Eastern Han tradition and later Daoist memory

zh-CN.title: 罗浮山
zh-CN.shortSummary: 罗浮山是葛洪传记、道教修炼和后世仙真记忆叠加的现实山地空间。
curatorialDescription: 地点条目把现实山地与仙传、炼丹叙事分开；地图坐标只表达山域参照。
zh-CN.researchNote: 葛洪具体居止、宫观沿革与地方记忆需按史料、碑刻和遗产资料拆分。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 东晋人物语境与长期道教山岳记忆

en.title: Mount Luofu
en.shortSummary: Mount Luofu is a real mountain landscape layered with Ge Hong biography, Daoist cultivation and later immortal memory.
curatorialDescription: The place record separates real terrain from immortal biographies and alchemical narratives; the map coordinate is a mountain-region reference only.
en.researchNote: Ge Hong's residence, institutional history and local memory require separate histories, inscriptions and heritage records.
en.timeLabel: Eastern Jin figure context and long Daoist mountain memory

displayDate.zh-CN: 东晋人物语境与长期道教山岳记忆
displayDate.en: Eastern Jin figure context and long Daoist mountain memory

zh-CN.title: 桑奇
zh-CN.shortSummary: 桑奇佛教遗址把阿育王、佛教纪念性建筑与后世遗产记忆放在同一现实地点层。
curatorialDescription: 桑奇以遗产地层级进入地图；阿育王柱、佛塔、造像和后世保护史仍需拆成物质对象与事件。
zh-CN.researchNote: 当前使用 UNESCO 遗产入口和近似遗址坐标；具体敕诏、营造和年代需要按遗址资料细化。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 阿育王时期至后世遗产空间

en.title: Sanchi
en.shortSummary: Sanchi brings Ashoka, Buddhist commemorative architecture and later heritage memory into one real place layer.
curatorialDescription: Sanchi enters at heritage-site level; pillars, stupas, images and conservation history still need separate object and event records.
en.researchNote: The current entry uses the UNESCO heritage gateway and an approximate site coordinate; edicts, building phases and dates require finer records.
en.timeLabel: From the Ashokan period through later heritage memory

displayDate.zh-CN: 阿育王时期至中世纪遗产记忆空间
displayDate.en: From the Ashokan period through a medieval heritage-memory horizon

zh-CN.title: 那伽朱那康达
zh-CN.shortSummary: 那伽朱那康达是南印度佛教遗址与龙树记忆之间的低精度区域锚点，不是龙树确证居所。
curatorialDescription: 地图以 approximate region 显示，明确区分遗址历史、人物命名传统和龙树生平证据。
zh-CN.researchNote: 遗址、地方命名和龙树传记关联需要考古报告与佛教史研究逐项核验；当前只作研究入口。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 南印度佛教遗址与龙树后世记忆

en.title: Nagarjunakonda
en.shortSummary: Nagarjunakonda is a low-precision regional anchor between a South Indian Buddhist site and memories associated with Nāgārjuna, not a confirmed residence.
curatorialDescription: The map uses an approximate region and explicitly separates site history, naming traditions and evidence for Nāgārjuna's life.
en.researchNote: Archaeology, local naming and biographical association require item-level Buddhist-history review; this is currently a research gateway.
en.timeLabel: South Indian Buddhist site and later Nāgārjuna memory

displayDate.zh-CN: 南印度佛教遗址与龙树后世记忆
displayDate.en: South Indian Buddhist site and later Nāgārjuna memory

zh-CN.title: 混沌与开辟
zh-CN.shortSummary: 盘古开辟叙事的象征空间，不是现实地点。
curatorialDescription: 该节点只进入神圣/神话画布，不参与现实距离、路线或历史地图计算。
zh-CN.researchNote: 不同开辟文本的层次和时代需继续区分。

en.title: Primordial cosmos
en.shortSummary: A symbolic space for Pangu cosmogenesis, not a real-world place.
curatorialDescription: This node belongs only to the sacred/mythic canvas and is excluded from real distance, route and historical-map calculations.
en.researchNote: Different cosmogenesis texts and their periods require further separation.

zh-CN.title: 补天与造人
zh-CN.shortSummary: 女娲造人、补天与秩序修复叙事的象征空间。
curatorialDescription: 该节点不对应某一座现实山或遗址；后世女娲庙与图像可另建 memory/cult site。
zh-CN.researchNote: 文本版本、地方祭祀与图像记忆尚未在本节点合并。

en.title: Nüwa cosmology
en.shortSummary: A symbolic space for Nüwa creation, sky-repair and restored-order narratives.
curatorialDescription: This node is not a real mountain or archaeological site; later temples and images can be modelled as separate memory/cult sites.
en.researchNote: Textual versions, local cults and visual memory are not merged in this node.

zh-CN.title: 八卦与方位
zh-CN.shortSummary: 伏羲八卦、方位和文明秩序叙事的象征空间。
curatorialDescription: 八卦的神话起源和后世解释不生成现实坐标，也不代表单一历史发明时刻。
zh-CN.researchNote: 后续可接入图像、文本版本和器物证据。

en.title: Trigram cosmos
en.shortSummary: A symbolic space for Fu Xi, trigrams, orientation and civilisational order.
curatorialDescription: Mythic origins and later interpretations of the trigrams do not generate real coordinates or one historical invention date.
en.researchNote: Images, textual versions and material objects can be connected in a later batch.

zh-CN.title: 昆仑与传说山岳
zh-CN.shortSummary: 西王母、黄帝与仙真叙事叠加的神圣山岳象征空间。
curatorialDescription: 昆仑在不同文本和宗教传统中具有不同层次；本节点不对应现实地图的昆仑山坐标。
zh-CN.researchNote: 后续应区分文本宇宙、地方山岳记忆和现实遗产地点。

en.title: Kunlun and legendary mountains
en.shortSummary: A sacred mountain symbol layered with Xi Wangmu, Huangdi and immortal traditions.
curatorialDescription: Kunlun has different layers across texts and religious traditions; this node is not a real-world coordinate for Kunlun Mountain.
en.researchNote: Textual cosmos, local mountain memory and real heritage sites should be separated in later work.

zh-CN.title: 道教天界
zh-CN.shortSummary: 太上老君与三清谱系的神圣宇宙象征空间。
curatorialDescription: 天界节点只用于展示道教神圣谱系，不生成现实经纬度，也不与老子历史活动地点合并。
zh-CN.researchNote: 具体经典、宫观祭祀和天界层次需要独立文本与仪式记录。

en.title: Daoist celestial realm
en.shortSummary: A sacred-cosmos node for Taishang Laojun and Three Pure Ones genealogies.
curatorialDescription: The celestial node shows Daoist sacred genealogy without real coordinates and without merging it with Laozi's historical activity places.
en.researchNote: Specific scriptures, temple rituals and celestial layers require separate textual and ritual records.
